## Published Work

### Uses and Gratifications Sought From Mobile Phones and Loneliness Among Japanese Midlife and Older Adults
*Innovation in Aging, 2020*

Mediation analysis examining how mobile phone use patterns relate to loneliness outcomes in a nationally representative Japanese sample.

- **Methods:** Mediation analysis, regression modeling
- **Tools:** Stata
- **[View Code on GitHub](https://github.com/honoluluhan717/Japan-loneliness-study)**
